The humans of Douluo invented weapons of mass destruction, mechanized armor, and living metals. With these advancements, they went on to conquer the oceans and discovered two new continents. To fuel these new technologies, humanity hunted the soul beasts to the very brink of extinction. 
Once the dominant force of Douluo, the few surviving soul beasts now hide in the darkest recesses of their last sanctuary. The weakest have all been hunted, leaving only the strongest to scheme in the heart of the forest. The soul beasts, not willing to fade away, plot an uprising for their survival. In the midst of this, a god from a long forgotten era awakens in the depths of the Great Star Dou Forest to seek vengeance for the soul beasts. 
As darkness encroaches from the abyss, hope is found in a young boy who holds a power beyond divinity within himself—Tang Wulin! He finds his way into the fabled halls of Shrek Academy, where he learns to wield his prodigious powers, makes friends and finds allies, eventually rising to become a towering leader. 
As he learns to harness his strength, danger lurks within the shadows as the various factions of humanity maneuver and plot to usurp Shrek Academy. Tang Wulin discovers the threat to the only world he knows as he sinks deeper into the intrigue. Meanwhile, camouflaged by the chaos and unbeknownst to the humans, the soul beasts’ plot continues to steadily advance.
To defend what he loves and reclaim what was lost, Tang Wulin must seek out the legacies of legends past and unlock the full might of the Golden Dragon King!

1018063.synopsis:
Power decides fate—
but what happens when fate makes the worst possible choice?
Reincarnated war-nerd Zhan Ge, whose only real-life experience with conflict was driving military supply trucks in Ukraine “for research purposes,” suddenly opens his eyes in 1903…
inside the body of Prince Oskar, the awkward, ignored fifth son of Kaiser Wilhelm II.
In the German Empire, he’s supposed to be noble.
Disciplined.
Patriotic.
Elegant.
Instead, he’s:
– socially anxious,
– addicted to military history,
– speaking German like an Austrian action hero, and
– climbing palace trees to hide from responsibility.
Branded “the strange prince,” never taken seriously, Oskar becomes the forgotten Hohenzollern—
the prince nobody needed.
But Zhan Ge knows something no one else in 1903 could even imagine:
Germany is racing toward a catastrophe.
The world’s first global war.
A disaster that will shatter empires, redraw continents, and erase millions.
If he does nothing, the German Empire collapses.
He loses his title, his home, his future, and—worst of all—
his chance at a peaceful life with a wife, money, food, and absolutely zero trenches.
To survive, Oskar must change history itself:
strengthen Germany without unleashing darker futures
stop the world from repeating its greatest tragedies
outsmart rival princes, generals, ministers
and avoid accidentally starting WWI early with an Arnold Schwarzenegger one-liner.
Armed with a century of historical knowledge, modern logic, and a dwarf attendant who constantly questions his sanity, the most unwanted prince of Prussia stands at the dawn of a new century…
Determined to reshape the fate of Europe or die trying.

1019087.synopsis:
Waking up in the year 2007—just before a certain billionaire builds a suit of armor in a cave—Ethan thought he had time to prepare for the approaching madness of the Marvel universe. He was wrong. Within seconds of his arrival, the Ancient One spots his multiversal anomaly and immediately "invites" him to Kamar-Taj.
Fortunately, Ethan didn’t arrive empty-handed. Bound to the Multiversal Template System, he has the power to unlock the skills, bloodlines, and sheer power of the multiverse’s greatest figures. Starting with the unparalleled magical genius Albus Dumbledore, Ethan is about to turn Kamar-Taj's ancient rules upside down.
Ethan knows the future. He knows the impending alien invasions, the heartbreaking sacrifices, and the tragedies written into the so-called "Sacred Timeline." And he has absolutely no intention of letting the script play out. Armed with an ever-expanding arsenal of multiversal magic, system-bought tech, and an absolute disregard for "canon," Ethan is going to save who needs saving and shatter the timeline in the process.
The Avengers haven't assembled yet. Thanos is still biding his time in the stars. And the Marvel universe is entirely unprepared for a transmigrator who treats magic like a playground and fate like a suggestion.
The timeline is about to be rewritten. And Ethan is holding the pen.

1019855.synopsis:
In the boundless Azure Veil Continent, where cultivation reigns supreme and desire serves as the hidden blade behind every throne, legends still whisper of the Void Empress. She was the unrivaled futanari sovereign who once shook the entire Jianghu with her forbidden Void Harmony Devouring Sutra.
Through raw ecstasy and absolute dominance, she could plunder a cultivator’s talent, steal their fortune, or drown them in unimaginable pleasure and power. Enemies shattered beneath her might while proud saintesses and heavenly geniuses willingly became addicted slaves in her ever-growing harem of peerless goddesses. Yet at the very cusp of Immortal Ascension, she was betrayed and her soul sealed away for a thousand years.
Now, the once-glorious Primordial Void Immortal Clan stands on the brink of annihilation. Their final hope lies with their proud and talented Young Mistress, Ling Zihan. In a desperate attempt to reverse their clan’s decline before the Azure Veil Grand Sect Tournament, she attempts a forbidden breakthrough using a sacred ancestral artifact, only to perish in agony.
The moment her heart stops beating, the ancient seal shatters.
The Void Empress awakens.
Reborn in Ling Zihan’s flawless body, now transformed into an ethereal silver-haired beauty radiating otherworldly temptation, she possesses something far more dangerous than before: a thick, spiritually potent futanari cock that serves as her Supreme Yang Furnace. With it, she can devour and refine essence through mind-shattering dual cultivation.
She is colder. Crueler. Infinitely more ambitious.
She will wear the mask of the arrogant Young Mistress perfectly. No one will suspect that the fallen clan’s final daughter is now the ancient demoness who nearly conquered the heavens.
Arrogant young masters will be trampled underfoot. Proud saintesses will be corrupted and collared by overwhelming pleasure. Those who once betrayed her will scream her name in both terror and ecstasy.
With every conquest, her power surges. With every harem member she claims, her Dao deepens. Enemies will be devoured, their talent, luck, and very souls refined into fuel for her ascension.
This time, nothing will stop her.
A dark xianxia tale of ruthless revenge, cold supremacy, addictive pleasure, and supreme dual cultivation, where the path to the peak is paved with broken geniuses and willingly corrupted beauties.
The Void Empress has returned. And the entire continent will kneel.

1021391.synopsis:
SOME STORIES ARE WRITTEN.
OTHERS WERE NEVER MEANT TO EXIST.
Every Canon has an Author.
But who writes the writers?
Elias Vance dies before finishing the final sentence of his novel.
He expects death.
Instead, he awakens inside the Shelves—an endless library where every book is a living world, every story is real, and powerful Editors travel across countless Canons to prevent fiction itself from collapsing.
Every mission is a different world.
Every Canon has its own magic, monsters, heroes, kingdoms, wars, mysteries, and rules.
Some worlds can be saved.
Others were never meant to survive.
Except…
Elias shouldn’t exist.
He has no Ink.
No classification.
No record.
The library says someone like him cannot exist.
Yet every impossible test points back to him.
Then something inside him wakes.
A broken Fragment from a legendary fallen hero begins merging with his soul, bleeding memories, instincts, skills, and power that were never his.
The more stories he enters…
the less certain he becomes about who he really is.
Then the impossible happens.
The unfinished novel Elias died writing…
starts writing itself.
Inside waits a dragon guarding the ending he never finished.
A ruined city buried beneath another story.
A second Elias who never stopped writing after his death.
And a truth that should never have existed.
Now every faction wants him.
• The Editors who protect reality.
• Forgers who harvest dying worlds.
• Creatures born from abandoned stories.
• Ancient Authors who refuse to disappear.
• And something older than every Story…
watching where fiction itself is born.
But the greatest threat isn’t any of them.
It’s Elias.
Every Canon he enters changes.
Every battle rewrites him.
Every power he gains steals another piece of who he used to be.
One day…
he won’t just save stories.
He’ll become the one capable of rewriting them all.
And if that day comes…
the next Story erased from existence…
might be ours.

Having transmigrated into the cultivation world, Li Ping, now over forty, finally succeeded in his Foundation Establishment.

The later realms of Core Formation, Nascent Soul, Divinity Transformation... these were not things a 'three-no' cultivator like him—with no background, no talent, and no opportunities—should even consider. He was already very satisfied just to have achieved Foundation Establishment.
“Having cultivated for half a lifetime, it's time for me to enjoy life.”
In the years to come, he planned to enjoy life to the fullest and, while he was at it, marry a few more beautiful female cultivators to expand his family.
But at that very moment, his cheat system finally arrived.
The moment he succeeded in his Foundation Establishment, a Purple Mansion Space suddenly opened up in his Sea of Consciousness, and within this space, a gray island slowly came into being.
On the island grew a Tree of Inheritance, which allowed him to instantly master a cultivation art.
Moreover, every time Li Ping broke through a major realm, a new island would be born within the Purple Mansion Space, endowing him with a heaven-defying Divine Ability!
[Time Acceleration], [Inference Skill], [Enhancement], [Extraction]...
